findings.current: “Go to the Inner Hall. Tell them this old man is coming.”
findings.defect: The source explicitly says to go to the Inner Hall right now; the translation omits that urgency.
findings.rationale: 지금 당장 means “right now” or “immediately.” The accepted baseline also preserved this timing detail.
findings.replacement: “Go to the Inner Hall right now. Tell them this old man is coming.”

summary: The assembled translation is faithful overall, with one minor omission of explicit urgency.
